home.description: Innovative web development, cutting-edge cybersecurity, and digital solutions that move your business into the future.

tabs.title: Our Mission
tabs.content: At CodeMark, our mission is to transform innovative ideas into cutting-edge digital solutions. We provide custom web development, advanced cybersecurity, and performance optimization services that drive our clients' success in the digital era.
tabs.summary: We transform ideas into innovative digital solutions

tabs.title: Our Approach
tabs.content: Our approach centers on technical excellence, robust security, and continuous optimization. We work closely with our clients, understanding their specific needs and business goals to deliver solutions that create real, lasting impact.
tabs.summary: Technical excellence and close collaboration with clients

tabs.title: Our Vision
tabs.content: We aspire to be leaders in the technology industry, recognized for our innovation, integrity, and commitment to excellence. We constantly seek new ways to use technology to solve complex challenges and create a safer, more efficient digital future for our clients.
tabs.summary: Leaders in technological innovation and excellence

tabs.title: Our Team
tabs.content: We have a diverse, highly qualified team of developers, designers, and security experts. Our passion for technology and commitment to continuous learning keep us at the forefront of the latest trends and best practices in web development and cybersecurity.

tabs.title: Our Impact
tabs.content: We strive to create a positive impact not only on our clients' businesses, but also on the technology community as a whole. We actively participate in industry events, contribute to open-source projects, and promote technology education to inspire the next generation of digital innovators.
tabs.summary: Positive impact on businesses and the technology community

meta.title: TacuFact web app
meta.description: TacuFact is CodeMark's SaaS web app for electronic invoicing, inventory, and sales in El Salvador.

appWeb.descriptionPrefix: At TacuFact, we understand the effort behind local businesses. Built so you can stop worrying about paperwork and focus on what you do best:

highlights.title: More than invoices
highlights.description: Manage inventory, sales, and electronic documents in one place, optimized for Salvadoran commerce.

highlights.title: Close to you, always
highlights.description: Forget support teams that take days. We are right here in El Salvador to help when you need it.

appWeb.featuresSubtitle: Tools designed for Salvadoran companies that want to comply with the law without losing time.

features.title: Electronic invoicing
features.description: Issue, review, and organize electronic tax documents with a simple and fast experience.

features.title: Connected inventory
features.description: Keep stock, movements, and products synchronized with every business sale.

features.title: Sales and reports
features.description: See revenue, daily activity, and key metrics to make better decisions.

features.title: Security by CodeMark
features.description: Built with good practices, access control, and a foundation ready to grow with your company.

features.title: Document management
features.description: Centralize receipts, customers, and records so everything is easy to find when needed.

features.title: Nearby support
features.description: Real guidance in your language and with local context so you never get stuck.

features.title: For your accountant
features.description: We also help your accountant with an exclusive user to manage accounting faster, in order, and without complications.

appWeb.dashboardTitle: A clear dashboard to sell, invoice, and grow.
appWeb.dashboardDescription: We designed the experience so any team can use it: fast on desktop, comfortable on mobile, and ready for real operations.
appWeb.accountantDescription: We know accounting is teamwork. That is why we include an exclusive user for your accountant, so they can manage your accounting faster, in order, and without complications.
